subject: inorganic
question:
无机化学·配体分类：下列配体属于哪一种 L/X 类型：salen (κ⁴-N,N,O,O)（salen）？
A. L₂X₂
B. L₂X
C. L₃
D. LX
explanation: salen (salen (κ⁴-N,N,O,O)) is an L₂X₂ ligand: each L gives 2 electrons and each X one, so 6 electrons in the covalent count (8 in the ionic count).
